name: Rest Position (Child's Pose)
summary: Sit back towards the heels with the arms long in front and breathe into the back.
steps: Kneel and sit back towards the heels.
Fold forward, arms long in front or resting by the sides.
Breathe into the back of the ribs.

layers.title: Side reach
layers.text: Walk both hands to one side.

modifications: Knees wide to make room for the belly or hips.
Cushion between heels and hips, or under the forehead.

cautions.note: Deep knee bend; pad behind the knees or skip.

cues:
Heavy hips.
Let the forehead rest.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
